item.title: Just Show Up: Why Learning Bitcoin Together Beats Learning Alone
item.description: Online in a Discord call or around a table at Bitcoin House Bali, learning Bitcoin with other people is faster, friendlier and better for everyone. Here is why it is worth showing up.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: Why Self-Custody Matters: Get Your Bitcoin Off the Exchange
item.description: Why leaving bitcoin on an exchange means holding an IOU, and three simple steps to start self-custody with a hardware wallet and a tested seed phrase backup.
item.dc:creator: Andy
